name: io.paymove/paymove-mcp
title: Paymove MCP Server
description: Official Paymove MCP server for payment links, checkouts, Pay&Go tickets, and parking zones.

headers.name: X-API-KEY
headers.description: Paymove Partner API Key generated in https://panel.paymove.io. Required for partner management tools (Pay, Pay&Go, Parking, and list-partner-products). Not required for public discovery (search-public-products, go-get-product, parking-get-pricing, list-pay-pricing-entries).

headers.name: X-SANDBOX-API-KEY
headers.description: Optional Paymove Sandbox API Key (starts with sk_test_) to route operations to the Paymove Sandbox environment.
